text:
Maya: Heads-up — AcmeCorp (acct-123) reporting Dedicated EU reserved pool spiking yesterday 2026-03-16 ~12:03UTC. Symptoms: transient 429s from reserved pool, then automatic fallback to hosted endpoints which produced unexpected hosted charges. Need triage + repro steps. Logs below.
Sam: Can you paste an example request_id and the raw response headers? also which reserved pool name? YYYY
Maya: pool=reserved-eu. sample log:
```
[2026-03-16T12:03:02Z] req=rx-9a1b2c resp=200 route=reserved-eu
[2026-03-16T12:03:15Z] req=rx-9a1b3d resp=429 x-rw-reason=reserved_pool_exhausted x-rw-tokens-left=0
[2026-03-16T12:03:16Z] req=rx-9a1b4f resp=502 x-rw-fallback=hosted fallback-route=small-gpu billing-tag=hosted-ingress acct=acct-123
[2026-03-16T12:03:17Z] req=rx-9a1b5a resp=200 route=hosted/small-gpu billed=true
```
Maya: customer says they saw a ~30m window of increased hosted spend, billing flagged it.
Kira: :eyes: That pattern looks like token-bucket underflow -> rapid 429s then our routing policy falls back to hosted variant. We should confirm token refill rate and burst tokens for reserved-eu.
Dave: Reserved pool config (current):
```
pool: reserved-eu
qps: 250
burst_tokens: 450
slo_headroom_percent: 20
route_policy: strict->fallback-hosted
```
Sam: Two quick hypotheses: 1) burst_tokens too small for Acme's traffic shape -> bucket empties and we return 429, then route_policy triggers fallback; 2) headroom config reserved too high so autoscaler didn't give extra capacity during short spike. Both lead to hosted calls.
Jules: From billing side: we see hosted calls billed to acct-123 with tags hosted-ingress. We can issue a temporary credit if infra confirms fallback was automatic and customer on Dedicated should not fall back to hosted by default. Need eng confirmation before crediting.
Maya: Repro plan I ran locally against staging reserved-eu: simple curl loop with concurrency 50 for 90s — snippet:
```
for i in $(seq 1 900); do 
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s\n" \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acct-123" \
    -H "X-Redwood-Route: reserved-eu" \
    https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate &
  if (( i % 50 == 0 )); then sleep 0.5; fi
done
```
Maya: Repro results (staging): first ~180 reqs 200 (reserved), then ~240 reqs 429, then ~60 reqs 502 fallback to hosted, then remainder 200 succeed on hosted. Logs show token count dropped to negative briefly: "token_delta: -5" in runtime logs.
Sam: Negative token count means we have a race between token check and refill scheduler. Can someone grep for "token_delta" logs and the allocator tick around 12:03:15? infra-bot: queued query.
infra-bot: query: show logs where message contains "token_delta" and pool=reserved-eu between 2026-03-16T12:02:30Z..2026-03-16T12:04:00Z -> 42 matches
Kira: Good. Action items proposal:
- Sam (SRE) to validate token-bucket logic and look for underflow race (owner)
- Dave (runtime) to evaluate increasing burst_tokens for reserved-eu or smoothing algorithm (owner)
- Jules (acct) to hold billing charge and prepare provisional credit if engineering confirms automated fallback (owner)
- Maya (support) to coordinate with AcmeCorp and collect any additional request ids (owner)
Sam: Quick mitigation we can patch: change routing policy so Dedicated pools do NOT auto-fallback to hosted unless account-level flag allows it. That would prevent hosting charge spikes but might raise latency errors for customers—need product decision.
Dave: Also we can bump burst_tokens to 800 for reserved-eu to match their 2x short-window spikes and add a short refill acceleration for 5s after sustained high QPS.
Jules: We'll hold off credits until Sam confirms fallback was not customer-triggered. If confirmed, billing will issue a one-time credit and we'll change billing tags to indicate charged-by-exception.
Maya: Customer update queued. They asked whether this is "intended behavior" — please confirm short-term mitigations so we can reassure.
Sam: ETA for initial investigation: 3 hours. If we confirm race underflow, quick fix: tighten token check order + telemetry + hotfix to prevent negative token deltas. Longer term: rethink fallback routing default for Dedicated.
Kira: Filed RW-4628 with the above details and assigned to Sam. :white_check_mark: Jules opened billing hold RW-4629.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll attach the full trace ids and billing invoices when I have them. :money_with_wings:
